meta.title: Da Fei Yu UI
meta.description: Paints a scene behind the conversation with a shark-girl figure at the right edge and a translucent scrim for readability, and retints the sidebars, composer, message bubbles, code blocks and file cards to match. Dark and light each have their own scene and palette while sharing one figure image. A Theme page in the sidebar navigation rail switches between them and keeps DSH's own Appearance setting in sync.
